title: The Life of a Star
subtitle: From molecular cloud collapse to supernova and cosmic seed dispersal.
summary: Track ten billion years of thermonuclear evolution through six critical epochs.

stages.title: Molecular Cloud & Nebula
stages.subtitle: The Cold Nursery
stages.description: Vast clouds of interstellar hydrogen gas and microscopic silicate dust gently condense over millions of years under subtle gravitational perturbations.
stages.scientificInsight: Jeans instability triggers pockets of gas to collapse when self-gravity overcomes thermal gas pressure.

stages.title: Protostar Formation
stages.subtitle: Gravitational Infall & Heating
stages.description: As the core densifies, gravitational potential energy transforms into infrared heat. Bipolar magnetic jets shoot matter millions of kilometers into space.
stages.scientificInsight: Accretion disks around the protostar gather matter that will later condense into planets and asteroids.

stages.title: Main Sequence Ignition
stages.subtitle: Thermonuclear Equilibrium
stages.description: Core temperatures breach 15 million degrees, initiating the proton-proton chain: fusing 600 million tons of hydrogen into helium every second.
stages.scientificInsight: Hydrostatic equilibrium maintains a perfect balance between outward photon radiation pressure and inward gravity.

stages.title: Red Giant Expansion
stages.subtitle: Helium Flash & Outer Swell
stages.description: Hydrogen depletes in the core. The inert helium core contracts while the hydrogen shell ignites, swelling the outer atmosphere into a luminous giant.
stages.scientificInsight: Triple-alpha processes begin fusing helium nuclei into carbon and oxygen in a sudden explosive flash.

stages.title: Supernova Cataclysm
stages.subtitle: Core Collapse & Heavy Element Nucleosynthesis
stages.description: Iron cannot yield net fusion energy. Within milliseconds, electron degeneracy fails, collapsing the core at 23% light speed before a violent shockwave rips through space.
stages.scientificInsight: Rapid neutron capture (r-process) synthesizes all heavy elements in the universe including gold, platinum, and uranium.

stages.title: Neutron Star / Black Hole
stages.subtitle: The Infinite Remnant
stages.description: The collapsed core remains as an ultra-dense city-sized sphere of pure neutrons spinning hundreds of times per second, or collapses beyond the event horizon into a gravitational singularity.
stages.scientificInsight: The expelled outer shells form planetary nebulae enriched with elements that will seed future solar systems and living organisms.

title: Into the Deep: Journey to the Hadal Abyss
subtitle: Descend 11,000 meters through the oceanic water column into eternal darkness.
summary: From the sunlit epipelagic surface down to the crushing pressures of the Challenger Deep.

stages.title: Epipelagic (Sunlit Zone)
stages.subtitle: 0 to 200 Meters
stages.description: Where photosynthesis fuels 90% of all marine life. Schools of tuna, pelagic sharks, and phytoplankton blooms flourish in sun-warmed currents.
stages.scientificInsight: Phytoplankton in this surface band produce more than 50% of the oxygen in Earth's atmosphere.

stages.title: Mesopelagic (Twilight Zone)
stages.subtitle: 200 to 1,000 Meters
stages.description: Sunlight fades to a ghostly indigo. Bioluminescence becomes the primary language of survival: siphonophores, lanternfish, and giant squid navigate the dim water.
stages.scientificInsight: Every night, the largest animal migration on Earth occurs as billions of mesopelagic animals swim upward to feed under the cover of darkness.

stages.title: Bathypelagic (Midnight Zone)
stages.subtitle: 1,000 to 4,000 Meters
stages.description: Total blackness where water temperature hovers at 4°C. Organisms like the anglerfish and vampire squid utilize luciferin-luciferase enzymes to cast bioluminescent lures.
stages.scientificInsight: Deep-sea snow—falling organic matter and dead plankton—provides the sole food energy source.

stages.title: Abyssopelagic (The Abyss)
stages.subtitle: 4,000 to 6,000 Meters
stages.description: Immense sediment plains covering over 60% of Earth's surface. Echinoderms, glass sponges, and tripod fish rest on silicate muds undisturbed for centuries.
stages.scientificInsight: Polymetallic nodules resting on abyssal clay take roughly three million years to grow just one centimeter in diameter.

stages.title: Hadal Zone & Hydrothermal Vents
stages.subtitle: 6,000 to 11,034 Meters
stages.description: V-shaped subduction trenches. Black smoker chimneys vent 400°C mineral fluids supporting chemosynthetic bacteria, tubeworms, and snailfish whose cells rely on trimethylamine oxide stabilizers.
stages.scientificInsight: Life at hadal depths proves biology can thrive completely independent of solar radiation, informing the search for life on Europa and Enceladus.

title: The Rise of a Civilization
subtitle: How human settlements transformed stone, water, and knowledge into enduring empires.
summary: From river valley agrarian beginnings to monument architecture, golden ages, and atmospheric rediscovery.

stages.title: Agrarian Settlement & Irrigation
stages.subtitle: The First Surpluses
stages.description: Transitioning from migratory foraging to riverbank cultivation along fertile alluvial floodplains like the Tigris, Euphrates, Nile, and Indus.
stages.scientificInsight: Grain surpluses enabled specialized labor: toolmakers, astronomers, priests, and architects.

stages.title: The Emergence of the City-State
stages.subtitle: Cuneiform, Code, and Walls
stages.description: Uruk, Mohenjo-Daro, and Memphis emerge. Writing systems develop to track grain storage and legal contracts, creating the first recorded human thoughts.
stages.scientificInsight: Standardized weights, measures, and calendrical systems allowed cross-regional trade networks to flourish.

stages.title: Imperial Monumentality & Golden Age
stages.subtitle: Engineering the Sacred
stages.description: Vast aqueducts, stone monoliths, astronomical observatories, and libraries store centuries of mathematical and botanical wisdom.
stages.scientificInsight: Structural vaulting and hydraulic engineering allowed cities to expand beyond natural river boundaries.

stages.title: Crisis, Drought & Fragmentation
stages.subtitle: The Shifting Climate
stages.description: Shifting monsoon patterns, soil salinization, trade disruptions, and internal pressures lead to political decentralization and city abandonment.
stages.scientificInsight: Pollen cores and cave speleothems correlate civilization collapses with abrupt global climate fluctuations.

stages.title: Subterranean Reclaim & Rediscovery
stages.subtitle: LiDAR and Deep Archaeology
stages.description: Centuries later, forests reclaim the plazas until airborne LiDAR laser pulses strip away vegetation to reveal forgotten megacities beneath jungle canopies.
stages.scientificInsight: Remote sensing has revealed that pre-Columbian Amazonian cities supported millions of people with sustainable terra preta soils.
